# MCN Webservices

> MCN Webservices is a full-service digital agency covering web design & development, AI automation, app development, SEO, and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization), helping businesses get found in both traditional search and AI-powered answers.

## About

MCN Webservices designs and builds websites and apps, automates business workflows with AI agents, and runs SEO and GEO programs so clients rank in Google and get cited by AI assistants like ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity.
